en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Khazr, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who is prejudicial, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Join him with a gang from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Khudr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
On the Day of Judgment Allah will join those who practice racial discrimination with a race in fire.”
